categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Lacks the Wallet label and modifies FinalizePSBT in node/RPC rather than wallet code; the category definition states that a PSBT change affecting only RPC without wallet code is rpc, not wallet.
categories.rationale: Excluded by category guidelines as a non-wallet PSBT RPC fix. The wallet counterpart (FillPSBT) was already addressed in PR #30357, leaving this PR to affect only node/RPC PSBT finalization.
